description: This file defines the 'uploader' class for handling file uploads, including configuration, validation, image resizing, thumbnail creation, localization, and callback handling within the KCFinder project.

classes.name: uploader
classes.description: Handles file uploading, validation, image processing, localization, and callback responses within the KCFinder project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the uploader, loads configuration, sets up directories, localization, and security measures.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Main method to handle file upload process, including validation, moving files, and generating responses.

methods.name: checkUploadedFile
methods.description: Validates the uploaded file for errors, extension, size, and image resize constraints.

methods.name: checkInputDir
methods.description: Validates and normalizes input directory paths for uploads.

methods.name: validateExtension
methods.description: Checks if the file extension is allowed for the specified type.

methods.name: getTypeFromPath
methods.description: Extracts the type from a given path.

methods.name: removeTypeFromPath
methods.description: Removes the type prefix from a path.

methods.name: imageResize
methods.description: Resizes images to fit within configured maximum dimensions.

methods.name: makeThumb
methods.description: Creates a thumbnail for the uploaded image.

methods.name: localize
methods.description: Loads localization strings based on language code.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Retrieves localized label strings, replacing placeholders.

methods.name: backMsg
methods.description: Handles error messaging and terminates execution.

methods.name: callBack
methods.description: Outputs JavaScript callback for upload completion, integrating with editors like CKEditor or TinyMCE.

methods.name: get_htaccess
methods.description: Provides default .htaccess configuration to disable PHP engine.
